idea-plugin.name: MCP Code Intelligence
idea-plugin.description:
MCP Code Intelligence exposes 13 IDE-level semantic analysis tools to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Stop burning tokens on grep. AI agents get direct access to the same understanding your IDE uses internally — type resolution, reference graphs, call hierarchies, data flow analysis, and safe cross-language refactoring. Every response includes a nextAction hint that guides the agent to the optimal follow-up call.

Why agents pick these over CLI

  • Zero false positives — reference search uses the IDE's semantic index, not text matching
  • Structured responses with file+line+column and nextAction hints — agents chain tools automatically
  • Refactoring is safe — rename/move/extract update every reference across Java/Kotlin/XML/Manifest
  • Works across Java, Kotlin, and mixed codebases — including Android, Compose, Room, Hilt, Retrofit, Navigation

Tools

  • resolve_symbol — Type and declaration location at a code position
  • find_symbol — Locate a symbol by simple or fully-qualified name (no grep!)
  • find_references — Usages, callers, callees, type hierarchy (by position OR qualified name)
  • get_scope — All visible symbols: locals, members, extensions, imports
  • query_project — Project overview, dependency impact, API surface, build variants
  • query_framework — Room / Retrofit / Hilt / Compose / Navigation structural views
  • analyze_data_flow — Nullability inference, forward/backward value propagation
  • analyze_quality — Complexity hotspots, dead code, clones, error handling
  • check_rules — Custom architecture dependency rules validation
  • structural_search — AST-based pattern search with IntelliJ SSR syntax
  • refactor — Rename, move, extract, safe delete, change signature across Java/Kotlin/XML
  • checkpoint — Create, list, rollback, and diff IDE Local History snapshots
  • sandbox — Decompile library classes, Java-to-Kotlin conversion, batch inspections

Highlights

  • Embedded Ktor HTTP server with Streamable MCP transport — zero external dependencies
  • One-click Cursor configuration from the built-in Tool Window
  • Per-tool metrics: invocation count, token usage, execution time
  • Supports both K1 and K2 Kotlin compilers

What's new in v2.0

  • 🆕 New find_symbol tool — dedicated name-based lookup, replaces overloaded resolve_symbol
  • 🆕 Every tool response now carries a nextAction hint to guide AI follow-up
  • ✏️ All tool descriptions rewritten for LLM pickability (explicit "USE THIS INSTEAD OF grep" triggers)
  • ⚠️ Breaking: resolve_symbol no longer accepts name/kind/scope/limit — use find_symbol
